<MethodEndpoint method={'get'} path={'/v1/admin/encryption'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

Whether encryption is turned on, whether this process holds the key-encryption key, every key that has ever protected `onboardings.context` (most recent first, retired ones included — retiring never destroys material), how often the key rotates on its own and when it next does, and how many onboardings the background sweep still has to move toward the chosen state. `progress` and `rotation.nextRotationAt` are both derived from the rows themselves, never stored counters.
